_readme: Consolidated price list built from price_list_2026.xlsx (3 branch sheets: Mwanza, Dar es Salaam/Kiluvya, Dodoma), 2026-09-25.

This is a NATIONAL price sheet with per-branch AVAILABILITY differences, not per-branch pricing - most products share one price across all 3 branches. Where 'price_consistent_across_branches' is false, or 'available_in_all_branches' is false, that's a real difference to confirm, not a parsing artifact.

canonical_match links each price-list row to product_master.json where the name could be confidently matched. null means no confident match was found - do not force one; confirm manually before seeding.

color_pricing describes how much colors OTHER than OffWhite/base cost, per category. pricing_type is either 'delta_per_sqmt_over_offwhite' (add this to the OffWhite price) or 'absolute_price_per_sqmt' (this IS the price for that color, regardless of the specific mold's OffWhite base price - flagged as an assumption where the category has molds with varying OffWhite base prices, e.g. Floor Tiles Slab/Combo).

Categories with no color_pricing entry (Trench Covers, Cubstones, Blocks, Culverts, Nguzo) are sold in one color only (grey/offwhite concrete) - matches product_master.json's 'plain' display_format for those categories.
